mapper.update: update practice_generated_content set space_slug = #{et.spaceSlug}, activity_slug = #{et.activitySlug}, phrase_slug = #{et.phraseSlug}, space_title_zh = #{et.spaceTitleZh}, activity_title_zh = #{et.activityTitleZh}, scene_tag_en = #{et.sceneTagEn}, coach_tip_zh = #{et.coachTipZh}, english_text = #{et.englishText}, chinese_text = #{et.chineseText}, pronunciation_hint = #{et.pronunciationHint}, difficulty = #{et.difficulty}, generation_source = #{et.generationSource}, status = 'active', provider_trace_id = #{et.providerTraceId}, retrieval_trace_id = #{et.retrievalTraceId}, model_name = #{et.modelName}, content_version = #{et.contentVersion}, generation_error_code = null, generation_expires_at = null, normalized_scene_text = null, retention_expires_at = case when owner_scope = 'installation' then cast( #{et.retentionExpiresAt,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.OffsetDateTimeTypeHandler} as timestamp with time zone ) else null end, updated_at = coalesce(#{et.updatedAt,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.OffsetDateTimeTypeHandler}, now()) where generated_content_id = #{et.generatedContentId} and status = 'draft'
mapper.delete: delete from practice_generated_content where generated_content_id in ( select generated_content_id from practice_generated_content where owner_scope = 'installation' and status in ('active', 'expired', 'rejected') and retention_expires_at <= #{retentionExpiresAtOrBefore,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.OffsetDateTimeTypeHandler} order by retention_expires_at asc, generated_content_id asc limit #{limit} for update skip locked ) and owner_scope = 'installation' and status in ('active', 'expired', 'rejected') and retention_expires_at <= #{retentionExpiresAtOrBefore,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.OffsetDateTimeTypeHandler}
